title: First solo letter
scenario: The first letter that appears exactly once.

intro.job: The first letter that appears exactly once.

idea.rule: Count the whole word first — the first letter you haven't seen yet isn't the first letter that appears once.
idea.detail: Whether a letter appears once depends on the WHOLE word — a letter can look lonely at the start and repeat later. So make two passes: first count every letter, then walk the word again and stop at the first letter whose count is 1.

model_restatement: Find the first letter in the word that occurs exactly once, and print it.

clarify.question: What if every letter repeats?
clarify.answer: Today there's always at least one solo letter.

clarify_fallback: Good question — assume the simple case.
blueprint: Walk the word keeping a set of letters seen. The first letter that isn't in the set is the answer — print it and stop.

checkpoints.prompt: First time through the loop — what is ch?
With the fix — after the counting loop finishes (iteration 5), what is counts?

why_line: The very first letter is never in an empty set, so the draft prints 's' straight away — before it has any idea that 's' comes back twice more.

explain.rule: Picking the first new face is calling 'only child!' at the first kid through the door — before her two brothers walk in.
explain.bridge: So what do you need to know about every letter before you can call one 'solo'?

fix.rule: Two passes: count everything first, then the first letter with count 1 is the answer.

walk.gloss: Pass one: every letter of the word.
Pass two: the first letter whose count is exactly 1 wins.

alternatives.note: word.count recounts for every letter — correct, but slow on long words.

hints: Iteration 1: is 's' in the empty set?
'Not seen yet' only means new SO FAR — 's' comes back later.
Count every letter first, then look for the first count of 1.

follow_up.fix_hint: Nothing to change — p repeats, so the first solo letter is a.

one_liner: Count the whole word first — the first letter you haven't seen yet isn't the first letter that appears once.
